verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS billing platform and its developer tooling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'usage' material covers metering customers' usage for billing, and the default-off customer emails are an adjacent setting; neither is a telemetry control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
